title: Model Hub subscription quota
description: Rate-limit windows of every hub-held subscription Source, parsed from the vendor's own model-free usage report that the engine reads with the bound grant. A report only: no consumer may feed it back into resolution, admission, or cooldown. It carries parsed fields only, never a grant, token, or raw upstream body. The optional `value` blocks price the Source's own metered usage at list API prices for comparison with the subscription fee; they are a valuation, never an amount charged, and their absence means not reported, never zero.

refresh_interval_seconds.description: How often the server re-reads one Source without a forced refresh.

sources.description: One entry per hub-held subscription Source, in Source order.

pending.description: Source IDs whose quota read was still in flight when this response was built. The read keeps running and lands in the cache; a client may re-read shortly instead of presenting those Sources as unavailable. Absent from documents produced before this field existed; read absence as empty.

plan.description: Plan the vendor last reported, whether or not it has a built-in fee (Claude's `team` and `enterprise` have none, nor does a Max tier the fee table does not know, reported as `max`). A read that names a plan replaces this one; a read that names none keeps it. Null until any read names one.

fetched_at.description: When `windows` was read. Null until the first good read.

state.description: ok: fresh windows. stale: the latest read failed and `windows` is the last good snapshot. auth_expired: the vendor refused the grant; `windows` may be the last good snapshot. unsupported: this vendor has no quota report. error: no good read exists yet.

error_key.description: Present exactly when `state` is not ok.

kind.description: session: the shared short window. weekly: the shared weekly window. model_weekly: a weekly window only one model draws on, named by `scope_model`. other: any window the server does not recognise, rendered from `label`.

label.description: Upstream name, whitespace-collapsed and bounded. Display copy for `other`; the UI composes its own copy for the known kinds.

scope_model.description: Present exactly for model_weekly: the upstream model name.

label_is_key.description: Present (true) when `label` (and `scope_model`, if any) is an upstream identifier rather than display text, so the UI may read it as words. Absent means show it as written.

PricedUsage.description: API-price valuation of one span of metered usage, at the current price table.

excluded_tokens.description: input + output tokens of usage whose model has no known price, left out of api_cost_usd.

api_cost_lower_bound.description: True when api_cost_usd is only a floor: some tokens are excluded, some requests have no token report, or some usage was metered before cache writes were captured on a model that lists a cache-write price above input. A floor can show a payback but never a shortfall.

basis.description: billing_cycle: the current cycle from the configured renewal day. rolling_30d: no cycle is known, so the trailing 30 local days ending today.

to_day.description: Today; usage after today does not exist yet.

renews_on.description: Next renewal day, present exactly for billing_cycle.

excluded_tokens.description: input + output tokens of usage whose model has no known price, left out of api_cost_usd.

api_cost_lower_bound.description: True when api_cost_usd is only a floor: some tokens are excluded, some requests have no token report, or some usage was metered before cache writes were captured on a model that lists a cache-write price above input. A floor can show a payback but never a shortfall.

Period.description: The span `multiple` compares with the monthly fee, and its valuation (same members as PricedUsage).

SourceValue.description: This Source's metered usage priced at list API prices, and how it compares with the plan's monthly fee.

price_table_date.description: Local date the models.dev price table was fetched; null when only local overrides priced anything.

pending.description: Present (true) when no models.dev price table has been read yet and a first fetch is running that is expected to land; the cost fields then cover only what local overrides price. A client may re-read shortly and say prices are being fetched rather than that there are none. Absent means no fetch is awaited: a table is in hand, or the last fetch failed.

plan_key.description: Fee-table key the plan resolved to (built-in: claude_pro, claude_max_5x, claude_max_20x, chatgpt_plus, chatgpt_pro_5x, chatgpt_pro; or a key the local override file defines), or null when the plan is unknown.

fee_usd.description: Monthly fee of the plan, from the built-in table or the local override file. Null when the plan or its fee is unknown; the page then shows no payback.

multiple.description: period.api_cost_usd / fee_usd, present exactly when fee_usd is positive.

week.description: The trailing 7 local days ending today.

ValueTotals.description: Sums across every Source that carries a `value` block.

pending.description: Present (true) when no models.dev price table has been read yet and a first fetch is running that is expected to land; the cost fields then cover only what local overrides price. A client may re-read shortly and say prices are being fetched rather than that there are none. Absent means no fetch is awaited: a table is in hand, or the last fetch failed.

period.description: Only the Sources with a known fee, so the multiple compares like with like. Null when no Source has a known fee.

sources.description: How many Sources the period totals cover.
